textContent.text: Since civil liberties are specifically about freedom from government interference, protections focus on limiting government powers. Most civil liberties in the United States are protected by the Bill of Rights and other amendments to the U.S. Constitution. The first five amendments protect some of the most important civil liberties, including the freedom of expression, the freedom to bear arms, and protections for people accused of crimes.
